gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Cut-stencil muscle, then quiet: Wallpoet shouts with a gap running through its letters, while Noto Sans Vithkuqi, a plain sans, keeps its throats open and its capitals barely taller than the lowercase.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Wallpoet is all stencil, with a break of paper cutting through every letter. It earns its place big and brief, while Noto Sans Wancho follows with a hulking lowercase, pressed down like thick chalk, and an e that gapes at its tip.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Commanding is how Wallpoet lands, its smooth curves split by a thin stencil line, with Noto Sans Warang Citi's words forming solid blocks beneath. The plain sans gives it wide channels into each counter.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-yi: Bold stencil letters lead in Wallpoet, their lowercase rising high with a slit of paper through each one. But Noto Sans Yi, with its deep midsection and hook-like rounds left unsealed, is the one that carries a professional, modern sans-serif page along.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-s: Stencil swagger up top: Wallpoet cuts a line of paper through its tall lowercase. And Noto Sans Zanabazar Square, a sans with a soaring x-height and wide gaps, stays approachable and crisp across a full stretch of reading.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-traditional-nush: Wallpoet is the commanding one, its smooth bends split by a stencil gap and its lowercase rising high. And Noto Traditional Nushu does the quieter work, a broad-nibbed sans stroke with bowls that fill the line.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-numans: Numans stretches out its letters with tracking pushed well past normal, and its s hangs its ends far from the spine. Wallpoet, meanwhile, is the one built to command, with stencil breaks and high lowercase, where Numans is a modern sans-serif made for calm reading.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-onest: Approachable Onest, a sans-serif with short ascenders above big bowls, sits under Wallpoet's stencil-cut, commanding capitals and high lowercase. Its monotone line meets the heading's slit of paper.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-open-sans: Stencil punch meets bulk: Wallpoet runs smooth curves split by a line of paper, and Open Sans, a sans with bulky lowercase proportions, reads without clogged curves. One announces; the other talks.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-orienta: Modern in outline, Orienta breathes through counters like a hollow reed cut open, with little height difference between its cases. But Wallpoet is the loud one, best at commanding attention with its stencil gap, while the plain sans holds the text.
